youtube_description:
Interviews of mentors and participants at this year's Young Rewired State.

Young Rewired State is an annual weekly hack conference that brings developers under the age of 18 together, to build cool things with government date. The week is about innovating, making friends, learning new skills and changing the world.

Young Rewired State now enters its fourth year.

http://youngrewiredstate.org

Produced by Keyone Productions: http://keyoneproductions.co.uk
